FISHING TRIPS · UNITED STATES

Free fishing days 2027 by state

47 US states have free fishing days: days when you can fish in public waters without a fishing licence. 10 states have published their 2027 dates. For the other states, this table gives the state rule and the 2026 dates. Bag limits, size limits and seasons still apply on a free day.

  • States with free fishing days47From each state agency
  • 2027 dates published10The others publish later
  • Open to visitors308 states: residents only

Plan a trip on a free fishing day

  • 30 states open their free days to visitors from other states: Alabama, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Delaware, Florida, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming.
  • 8 states limit the free days to residents: Georgia, Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Mississippi, North Dakota, Ohio, South Carolina. A visitor buys a licence there on every day.
  • Most free days are in June. These states also have free days in winter or on autumn holidays:
    • Florida: Freshwater: first Saturday and Sunday in April, second Saturday and Sunday in June. Saltwater: first Saturday and Sunday in June, first Saturday in September, Saturday after Thanksgiving.
    • Maine: February 13-14, 2027 and June 5-6, 2027
    • Michigan: February 14-15, 2026 and June 13-14, 2026
    • Minnesota: January 16-18, 2027; May 8-9, 2027; June 4-6, 2027
    • New Hampshire: January 17, 2026 and June 6, 2026
    • New York: February 14-15, June 27-28, September 26 and November 11, 2026
    • North Dakota: June 5-6, 2027 and December 26-27, 2027
    • Oregon: February 14-15, June 6-7 and November 27-28, 2026
    • Vermont: Two free fishing days each calendar year: one in the open water season and one in the ice fishing season (10 V.S.A. 4251(b))
    • Wisconsin: January 16-17, 2027; June 5-6, 2027
  • A free day removes the licence only. Some states keep species tags, report cards, trout permits or park entry fees. The rule column shows what each agency says.
  • For the other days of a trip, compare non-resident licence prices for 3 days, 7 days and a full year.

Not confirmed from an official source: Alaska, Hawaii, South Dakota. These states are not in the table.

Questions

What is a free fishing day?

A free fishing day is a day when a state lets people fish in its public waters without a fishing licence. Bag limits, size limits, seasons and gear rules still apply.

Which states have announced free fishing days for 2027?

10 states in this table have published 2027 dates: California, Georgia, Idaho, Maine, Minnesota, North Carolina, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Washington, Wisconsin. The other states publish their dates later; the table gives the state rule and the 2026 dates.

Can non-residents fish on a free fishing day?

In 30 states the free days are open to visitors. 8 states limit them to residents: Georgia, Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Mississippi, North Dakota, Ohio, South Carolina. For the other states, ask the agency before you travel.

Do I need a trout stamp or tag on a free fishing day?

It depends on the state. Some states also remove the stamp or permit for the day. Other states still require report cards, tags or special permits. Read the rule for the state in the table and confirm on the official source.
